Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.scheduler

Class PipelineHealthService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.scheduler.PipelineHealthService
@Service public class PipelineHealthService extends Object
Centralized pipeline health service providing pre-flight validation, run tracking, and dry-run support for admin pipeline management.

Pre-flight checks validate that required prerequisites (API keys, vector store, network) are available before a pipeline runs. Run tracking stores the last execution result per pipeline in memory.

    • preFlightCheck

      public List<String> preFlightCheck(String pipelineId)
      Runs pre-flight validation for a given pipeline, returning a list of warnings. An empty list means the pipeline is ready to run.
      Parameters:
      pipelineId - the pipeline identifier
      Returns:
      list of warning messages; empty if all checks pass
